name: Quillet
tagline: cmux's own type family for agent chats: a sans for the interface, a serif for replies, a mono for code.
description: Quillet Sans, Quillet Serif and Quillet Mono, three openly licensed faces that share one line box, set for 15 px prose at a 1.6 line height. It picks the Quillet theme file, which sets only type, so your colors stay. Remove it and everything you had comes back.
